title: Why Are Your Cities Built There?

voice.direction: A curious surveyor thinking out loud. Assured, slightly wry on the hook ('without a reason'), a real question on 'Why here?', then four short, ticked-off findings with a small lift on each, a beat of discovery on 'the same spot', warm and practical on the advice, conversational on the CTA. No trailer voice.

lines.text: Nobody builds a great city in the middle of nowhere without a reason.
Before Ostral, this valley was empty. Why here?
Fresh water at the river bend.
A hill no army can take by surprise.
And two trade roads meeting right below.
Every reason lands on the same spot.
Give every city a reason to exist, and your map tells its own history.
Comment the most unusual place you'd build a city.

shots.purpose: Stop the scroll on the finished answer: a great city wrapped in a river bend, crowned by a citadel, with roads meeting at its bridge. The title says there's a reason.
shots.visual: Golden aerial of Ostral: citadel on a rock inside a river bend, roofs spilling to the water, docks, a bridge where two roads meet. Title 'NO GREAT CITY / by accident.'
shots.camera: Slow pull back (1.08 to 1.00) to reveal the whole bend.
shots.lighting: Warm late sun, haze; top scrim for the title.
shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. A great medieval-fantasy city seen from a high hillside vantage at golden late afternoon, in a broad green river valley. A wide calm river enters from the lower left, sweeps in a big bend around the centre of the frame and leaves toward the upper right. Inside the bend, in the exact centre of the frame, rises a solitary steep rocky hill crowned by a pale stone citadel with round towers; the city's terracotta roofs and stone walls cover the hill and spill down to the riverbank, with docks, moored boats, a long stone bridge and a busy riverside market square at the foot of the hill. Two dusty roads come from far away, one from the left and one from the right, and meet at the bridge below the hill. Flat green floodplain fields and orchards line the river. Distant blue hills on the horizon, open pale sky in the upper third. Painterly realism, atmospheric perspective, 35mm anamorphic look, soft film grain, original architecture. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.
shots.videoPrompt: (Not used: no image-to-video available. Motion is a Remotion pull-back.) Slow aerial pull-back over the river city, boats drifting, 4 seconds
shots.onScreenText: Title 'NO GREAT CITY' (amber kicker) + 'by accident.' (ember serif italic).
shots.transition: Hard cut on 'Before' to the same valley, empty.
shots.music: D minor add9, open: a confident question.

shots.purpose: The same kind of valley before the city: wild meadow, a river loop, a lone limestone hill. A surveyor's stake drops on the hill and asks the episode's question.
shots.visual: Untouched valley: river loops around a lone white-cliffed hill; two faint paths meet at a gravel bar below it. A survey stake drops onto the hilltop with a '?' badge; four empty slots appear across the top.

layers.midground: the hill inside the river loop, gravel bar

shots.lighting: Same golden hour as the hook, so the cut reads as the same place, centuries earlier.
shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. An untouched, completely uninhabited broad green river valley seen from a high grassy hillside vantage at golden late afternoon, long before any town existed. A wide calm river flows from the distance at the top centre, curves down the left side of the frame, then sweeps around in a big loop across the lower middle of the frame and out to the right edge. Inside this river loop, in the exact centre of the frame, rises a solitary steep rocky hill of pale grey limestone cliffs with grass and a few trees on its flat top. Wide flat floodplain meadows of lush green grass and wildflowers line both riverbanks, wet and fertile. Two faint narrow dirt footpaths come from the left and right edges of the valley and meet at a shallow gravel bar in the river just below the hill. No buildings, no walls, no bridge, no fields, no people, wild grassland and scattered trees only. Distant blue hills on the horizon, open pale sky in the upper third. Foreground: grassy hillside with rocks. Painterly realism, atmospheric perspective, 35mm anamorphic look, soft film grain. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.
shots.videoPrompt: (Not used.) Wind moving through the meadow grass, river glinting, 3.5 seconds
shots.onScreenText: Survey stake with a '?' badge on the hilltop; four empty slots: WATER, SOIL, DEFENSE, TRADE.
shots.transition: Continuous: same plate, the survey begins.
shots.music: B-flat major 7, sparse: before anything existed.

shots.purpose: Reasons 1 and 2 surveyed on the empty valley itself: the river (water) and the flood-renewed meadows (soil).
shots.visual: A translucent water-blue band traces the whole river loop; dashed ember outlines hatch the floodplain meadows. The WATER and SOIL slots fill.
shots.camera: Push (1.04 to 1.08), continuous with the previous shot.
shots.lighting: Same plate; overlay colours from the series palette plus the water motif.
shots.onScreenText: Water-blue river band; ember-dashed floodplain; tally: WATER ✓, SOIL ✓.
shots.transition: Hard cut on 'A' up onto the citadel wall.
shots.music: F major, 70 bpm pulse enters: the survey.

shots.purpose: Reason 3, defense: from the hilltop you see an army hours before it arrives, and the cliffs do the rest.
shots.visual: Guards on the citadel wall above a sheer cliff look out over open valley; amber sightlines fan from the tower to the far road. DEFENSE fills.
shots.camera: Slow push (1.18 to 1.22), frame raised 150–200 px so the guards' heads sit above the caption band.

layers.foreground: battlements and two guards seen from behind
layers.background: open valley and the long road

shots.lighting: Golden side light, long view into haze.
shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. On the battlements of a pale limestone citadel with round towers and terracotta-roofed turrets, built on the top of a sheer rocky cliff. Upper half: from the wall walk, a vast open green river valley spreads below in every direction, flat floodplain and a winding river, with a long empty road visible for miles to the distant blue hills, nowhere for an army to hide. Lower half: the crenellated stone wall in the foreground, the cliff dropping steeply away, and two guards in simple blue-grey tunics and steel caps seen from behind at a modest distance, one pointing toward the horizon. Golden late-afternoon light, a long view, haze in the distance, swallows in the air. Faces not visible. Painterly realism, atmospheric perspective, 35mm anamorphic look, soft film grain, original architecture and clothing. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.
shots.videoPrompt: (Not used.) Swallows wheeling over the battlements, banner-less wind on the wall, 3 seconds
shots.onScreenText: Amber sightlines from the tower across the valley; tally: DEFENSE ✓.
shots.transition: Hard cut on 'And' down to the market.
shots.music: G minor over the pulse: vigilance.

shots.purpose: Reason 4, trade: two long-distance roads meet below the hill, so carts, mules and boats all stop here.
shots.visual: Riverside market at the hill's foot: ox carts from one road, mule trains from the other, boats unloading at the quay. Two amber road lines converge on the square; a survey ring closes where they meet. TRADE fills.
shots.lighting: Warm dusty late light; river glare on the right.
shots.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy documentary still. A busy riverside market square at the foot of a rocky hill in a medieval-fantasy city, seen from a slightly raised angle at golden late afternoon. Two roads enter the square from opposite sides: from the left a line of ox carts loaded with grain sacks and timber, from the right a line of pack mules with bales of cloth and casks, both converging on the crowded square. In the middle, canvas-awninged stalls with baskets of fish, bread, pottery and spices, traders bargaining. On the right, a stone quay on the wide calm river with flat-bottomed river boats unloading cargo by rope and pulley. Behind and above, terracotta-roofed houses climb the steep limestone hill to a pale stone citadel with round towers. Warm dusty light, people small to medium, faces not visible or turned away. Painterly realism, atmospheric perspective, 35mm anamorphic look, soft film grain, original architecture and clothing. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.
shots.videoPrompt: (Not used.) Carts and mules plodding into the square, awnings stirring, 3 seconds
shots.onScreenText: Two amber road lines converging; survey ring on the square; tally: TRADE ✓.
shots.transition: Hard cut on 'Every' back to the empty valley.
shots.music: C major, 76 bpm with arpeggios: commerce.

shots.purpose: The payoff, shown not told: all four survey layers on one plate overlap on a single point, the hill, and it lights up.
shots.visual: Back on the empty valley: water band and soil hatch already there; a defense ring draws round the hill; both paths draw to the gravel bar below it; rings converge on the hilltop stake and a warm glow blooms.
shots.camera: Pull back (1.08 to 1.00) to the full valley, ending on the hook's framing.
shots.lighting: Plate darkens slightly so the glow reads.
shots.onScreenText: All four layers on the valley; converging rings and glow on the hilltop.
shots.transition: Dissolve (0.8 s) from the glowing empty hill to the city standing on it.
shots.music: B-flat to A major: the dominant, holding its breath.

shots.purpose: Reveal and lesson: the city now stands exactly where the reasons overlapped; the four icons sum to one instruction.
shots.visual: Dissolve to Ostral; the glow fades on the citadel. The tally bracket closes under the four icons and the line lands: GIVE EVERY CITY / a reason to exist.
shots.lighting: Plate dimmed at the top under the type.
shots.onScreenText: Tally bracket → 'GIVE EVERY CITY' + 'a reason to exist.'
shots.transition: Dissolve (0.6 s) to the city at dusk.
shots.music: D major with bells: the answer.

shots.purpose: Comment CTA over Ostral at dusk with its windows lighting up; ends on the hook's first frame for a loop.
shots.visual: The city at dusk, windows lit, the river glowing. Full logo, Episode 07 / 50, the CTA in large serif type, 'Comment below' pill.
shots.camera: Settles toward the hook's first framing (1.03 to 1.08, matching its start).
shots.lighting: Dusk grade with city lights in code; last 0.6 s cross-fades to the golden first frame.

graphics.title: Why are your cities built there?

shots.onScreenText: Full logo, 'EPISODE 07 / 50', title, 'YOUR TURN', 'Comment the most unusual place you'd build a city.', pill 'Comment below'.
shots.transition: Cross-fade into the hook's first frame for a seamless loop.
shots.music: G to D major, warm; fades fully before the last frame.

lesson: A city exists because several reasons overlap on one spot (water, soil, defense, trade). Give every settlement on your map its reasons, and the map starts explaining its own history.

music.key: D minor, resolving to D major
